text:
Ellie B.: Received invoice INV-AU-2026-07 for $4,275 from Aurora Cloud. PDF has no PO and line says 'platform credits'. Due in 7 days. Can procurement confirm a matching PO?
Invoices Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-AU-2026-07 \u2022 amount $4,275 \u2022 status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-AU-2026-07
Marcus (Procurement): Searching the PO system... we have PO-82411 for Aurora monthly credits at $3,500. Looks like this invoice includes a one-off training credit of $775.
Aurora Billing: Hi all \u2014 our billing export omitted PO when supplemental charges are present. We can reissue INV-AU-2026-07-R1 with PO-82411 on the header and line items showing $3,500 applied to the PO and $775 as 'training services'. Which would you prefer?
Ellie B.: Reissue with PO-82411 on the header is fine. Please show the training line separately and include remittance info.
Nate (AP): If PO appears on header we can auto-match $3,500. The $775 training line will need cost owner approval and finance review if not in scope. Please include GL mapping on the PDF if possible.
Anika (Finance Manager): Routing note: any invoices with misc services >$500 need my sign-off. Please map the training charge to GL 5405-TRAIN and cost center ops-data if applicable.
Marcus (Procurement): I'll issue supplemental PO if needed: PO-82411-S1 for training. If Aurora can include both PO numbers on the reissue that will speed matching.
Aurora Billing: We'll reissue INV-AU-2026-07-R1 today with PO-82411 and PO-82411-S1, break out line items, include GL/ledger mapping field and remittance info.
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-AU-2026-07-R1 uploaded \u2022 amount $4,275 \u2022 status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-AU-2026-07-R1
Nate (AP): Got it. Matched $3,500 to PO-82411. Routing training $775 to Anika for approval.
Anika (Finance Manager): Reviewed and approved the $775 training charge to GL 5405-TRAIN, cost center ops-data. Clear for payment.
Nate (AP): Scheduling payment on the next run. Closing ticket: "Aurora invoice missing PO when supplemental training charge present; reissued INV-AU-2026-07-R1; PO-82411 + PO-82411-S1; charge GL 5405-TRAIN; routed to Anika." :white_check_mark:
Aurora Billing: Thanks for the quick turnaround. We will flag exports to include PO fields on mixed invoices going forward.
Ellie B.: Thanks everyone for the fast response.
